name: Endless Summer Time ~Anata to Sugosu Tokubetsu na Natsu~
original_name: ENDLESS SUMMER TIME　〜 貴方と過ごす特別な夏〜
source:
A Persona 4 parody, with an emphasis on Adachi and the protagonist.

It starts from the 13th of August, after the investigation team have defeated Mitsuo and his dungeon, a time in P4 where the tension is at its lowest. The lives of the investigation team are filled with eating watermelon and festivals as opposed to bodies hanging from telephone poles being obscured (along with the truth) by a dense fog.

As the protagonist goes through working at Junes, hanging out with his friends and having easygoing chats with his uncle and cousin, something darker lurks at the back of his mind. He still has cryptic dreams, but they’re beginning to have a larger impact on him. Him starting to see Adachi as not just his uncle’s subordinate, not just an officer in charge of the case, but as as an actual person is what curiously triggers that change.

[taken from [url=http://goldensneer.wordpress.com/2012/08/01/even-in-dreams/]here[/url]]
